Services

Three details. One clear price each.

Four services, one standard: attention to detail. Prices depend on your vehicle's size, condition and needs.

01

Full Service Detailing

Inside-and-out detailing that restores your showroom shine, from the wheels to the windows.

02

Exterior Detailing

Wash, clay bar, paint polish, then wax or sealant, with wheels, tires and trim finished too.

03

Interior Detailing

Deep cleaning of seats, carpets, mats, dash and door panels, with conditioning for leather and vinyl.

04

Ceramic Coating

A durable barrier against UV, chemical stains and contaminants that makes your paint glossier and easier to clean.

05

Window Tinting

Precision-applied tint film with a bubble-free finish, for UV protection, less glare and a cooler cabin.

06

Paint Protection Film

Partial Front, Full Front, Track Pack or Full Vehicle coverage against scratches, chips and road debris.
